title: Multicenter retrospective evaluation of the influence of bridging therapy on efficacy of CAR T cells in aggressive lymphoma
summary: Today's bridging seems almost arbitrary and lacks any standard. This is mainly due to a lack of sufficiently granular data. This needs to be changed.

interventions.name: In patients who receive autologous CAR T cells, i.e., their own cells, peripheral blood cells are first collected.
